description_en: Updates the mutable configuration of a specified model connection and resubmits the publish task. The protocol cannot be modified after the model connection is created
description_zh: 更新指定模型连接的可变配置并重新提交发布任务；调用协议创建后不可修改
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore update-model-connection --workspace-id ws-1 --connection-id mc-1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateModelConnection

fields.help_en: The list of API keys used to access the upstream model service. The list must contain at least one non-empty value
fields.help_zh: 用于访问上游模型服务的 API Key 列表，至少包含一个非空值
fields.name: api_keys

fields.help_en: The description of the model connection. The description can be up to 255 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 模型连接描述，最长 255 个字符
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The absolute HTTP or HTTPS address of the upstream model service. The address can be up to 1024 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 上游模型服务的绝对 HTTP 或 HTTPS 地址，最长 1024 个字符
fields.name: endpoint

fields.help_en: The model connection name. The name must be 1 to 128 non-whitespace characters in length
fields.help_zh: 模型连接名称，长度为 1～128 个非空白字符
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The model invocation protocol. Currently, only OpenAI/v1 is supported. If not specified in Settings when the model connection is created, this default value is used
fields.help_zh: 模型调用协议。当前仅支持 OpenAI/v1，创建模型连接时未设置则使用该默认值
fields.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The client token used for idempotence. Not currently supported
parameters.help_zh: 幂等使用的客户端令牌。暂不支持
parameters.name: client_token

schema.description_en: The model text response returned when model testing succeeds. This value is empty when testing fails
schema.description_zh: 模型调试成功时返回的模型文本响应；调试失败时为空

code.description_en: The business status code. The value SUCCESS indicates success
code.description_zh: 业务状态码。成功时为 SUCCESS

data.description_zh: 更新后的模型连接信息

apiKeyCount.description_en: The number of API keys configured in the model connection
apiKeyCount.description_zh: 模型连接中已配置的 API Key 数量

createdAt.description_en: The time when the resource was created, in RFC 3339 UTC format
createdAt.description_zh: 资源创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

credentialConfigured.description_en: Indicates whether access credentials have been configured for the model connection
credentialConfigured.description_zh: 是否已为模型连接配置访问凭据

description.description_en: The description of the model connection. The description can be up to 255 characters in length
description.description_zh: 模型连接描述，最长 255 个字符

endpoint.description_en: The absolute HTTP or HTTPS address of the upstream model service. The address can be up to 1024 characters in length
endpoint.description_zh: 上游模型服务的绝对 HTTP 或 HTTPS 地址，最长 1024 个字符

name.description_en: The model connection name. The name must be 1 to 128 non-whitespace characters in length
name.description_zh: 模型连接名称，长度为 1～128 个非空白字符

protocol.description_en: The model invocation protocol. Currently, only OpenAI/v1 is supported. If not specified in Settings when the model connection is created, this default value is used
protocol.description_zh: 模型调用协议。当前仅支持 OpenAI/v1，创建模型连接时未设置则使用该默认值

updatedAt.description_zh: 资源最后更新时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式
